en: A black-and-white image of an old, rustic building with a large arched entrance and closed wooden shutters on the windows. The facade is partially covered with climbing plants or ivy. There is a sign on the wall under the windows, and the building faces a narrow, unpaved street with other similar structures visible further down. Dense forested hills rise in the background.
